name: Sonomura Meiko
source:
The main character's fiancée, they live together.

She is the one who teaches him how happy and precious a “peaceful life” is.

She worries about the protagonist, who works late all the time, and is waiting for him with a warm home-cooked meal.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=719516]getchu[/url]]
